question: Which of the following is equivalent to coulomb per second?
solution:
The correct answer is__ ampere__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Coulomb per second is equivalent to ampere.
 
• One coulomb is the charge flowing through a wire in 1 second if the current is 1 Ampere.
 
• A coulomb is a unit of electric charge.
 
• A coulomb is a name given in the memory of French physicist Charles Augustin de Coulomb.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Faraday** is the SI unit of capacitance.
 
• **Volts** is the SI unit of Electric Potential.
 
• **Ohm** is the SI unit of resistance.
